_doc: The frozen official W7900 campaign (2026-11-03) that produced every published number in README/docs. Only these run directories under evidence/results/ are aggregated by `python -m lab report` (reference scope). Student/smoke/duplicate runs can never contaminate the published medians: new measurements are written under runs/ and are excluded here by construction. Smoke runs are excluded by policy (bounded, non-protocol); B0 has TWO independent sessions (reproducibility arm, r1+r2) which is why its published median pools 18 measured runs while every other experiment pools 9.

excluded_from_reference.smoke-b0-B0-smoke: smoke run (bounded, non-protocol) — never a published median
excluded_from_reference.p5-H1-H1-cpu-te: H1 negative-result probe (own JSON, summarized separately)
excluded_from_reference.p5-H1-r2-H1-cpu-te: H1 rerun (reproducibility arm of the probe)
excluded_from_reference.p5-H2-H2-pipeline: H2 pipeline A/B (own JSON, summarized separately)
